question: Why did football's lawmakers retreat, after two seasons, from disallowing every goal that followed an accidental attacking handball?
answer: Because it punished bad luck. From 2019 any accidental touch on an attacker's arm just before a goal wiped the goal out, even when the ball had struck a team-mate's arm in the build-up. From 2021 only the scorer's own accidental handling, immediately before scoring, cancels the goal; a team-mate's no longer does.
move: A rule written to remove all doubt often removes the innocent too.
ask: Which rule I enforce removes all doubt by also punishing people who did nothing wrong?
reference: International Football Association Board, Laws of the Game 2021/22, Law 12 Fouls and Misconduct, Handling the ball
